myReference: I had a great time hosting Will here in Bogotá! We went for a walk around the city, took some pictures and videos, and I showed him some of my favorite spots. He was curious, respectful, and really interested in the local culture. He even tried a traditional Colombian dessert and loved it! Will is easygoing, friendly, and great company — I really enjoyed spending time with him. I’d definitely recommend him to other hosts in the Couchsurfing community! Count on me anytime you come Bogotá :)

theirReference: I met Cristian during my trip to Bogota, and I can honestly say he made my 3 days there unforgettable. Even before I arrive, we were already in touch, and it felt like I had a friend waiting for me in the city. From the moment I landed til my last day, he was there. Friendly, easy to talk to (esp that he knows english) and very genuine. On my 1st day, I invited him to my hotel and we went up to one of the most beautiful rooftop bars in Bogota to watch the sunset, had drinks, and get o know each other. We instantly clicked, finding so many similarities in life that made conversations flow so naturally. The next day he, he spend his whole time showing me around Bogota, from the breathtaking view on top of Monserrate to walking through the charming streets of La Candelaria where he even revealed his own “secret spots.” We tried delicious Cholado in a hidden corner. He wasn’t just a guide but was my new friend, and someone who shared his city with pride. Tnx for the memories and goodluck!
